about: Ground truth for bench/requirements_fixture.py, written by hand from the scripted history; never generated from a model or from docwizz output. links: the work items each method truly implements (the intent behind its changes), with the status a correct resolver can give from the exported evidence: confirmed (a directly linked commit), candidate (only a PR link), or none (the evidence doesn't show it: a denied lookup, a rename). outcome: what docwizz requirements show must answer. constraints: phrases (any one, case-insensitive) a grounded description of the requirement contains. contradicts: where the code does not do what the requirement asks. budgetStress: why the method's requirements exceed the default bound (3 items, 1200 characters).
